intervals.label: proposal and design studies
intervals.note: Month from the 2026 project talk (2011.12); Physics World says it was first proposed in 2011 by Zhao Guangda. Design documents: Physics & Detector CDR (arXiv:2303.15790, 2023), accelerator CDR (arXiv:2509.11522, 2025). The accelerator CDR 'aims to secure support from the Chinese central government for its construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030)'; the June 2026 talk says the proposal was submitted in 2025 and defended for inclusion in that plan. No approval is reported in the sources fetched (as of 2026-10-26).
intervals.quote: Proposed at “workshop for acc. Based high energy physics development strategy”

name: STCF spectrometer (conceptual design)
notes: A concept: no detector has been built. No placement is recorded: the host area (Hefei Future Big Science City) has no hall position, and a placement on the area-marker site would add an A23 approximate-coordinate warning; the experiment is located through facility:stcf-hefei and accelerator:stcf.

summary.plain: The conceptual STCF detector: a pixel or gas-detector inner tracker and drift chamber, ring-imaging and time-of-flight particle identification, a pure caesium iodide calorimeter and muon chambers inside a 1-tesla solenoid, covering 94% of the full solid angle.
summary.technical: STCF conceptual design (Physics & Detector CDR 2023): µRWELL inner tracker (6, 11, 16 cm) or CMOS MAPS option, main drift chamber, RICH with CsI-MPGD photon detectors (barrel), DIRC-like TOF (endcaps), pure CsI + APD calorimeter, RPC + scintillator-strip muon detector, 1 T superconducting solenoid, solid-angle coverage 94% of 4π.

technology.note: The quote supports the µRWELL inner-tracker option; the other subsystems are listed in the DIS2024 talk (slide 'STCF Detector Conceptual Design', J. Liu): drift chamber, RICH with CsI-MPGD in the barrel, DIRC-like TOF in the endcaps, pure CsI + APD, RPC + scintillator strips, 1 T solenoid, 94% of 4π.
technology.quote: consisting of three cylindrical layers located 6, 11 and 16 cm away from the interaction point, is proposed as a baseline option for the inner tracker
technology.value: Inner tracker (µRWELL or CMOS pixels), drift chamber, RICH and DIRC-like TOF, pure CsI + APD calorimeter, 1 T superconducting solenoid, RPC + scintillator muon detector
